title: Euler dataset modality meta schemas
description: Defines shared and modality-specific meta fields for each modality.key value.

depth.description: Required meta fields when modality.key is 'depth'.

dimensions.description: Dataset-wide nominal sample dimensions keyed by semantic axis names (for example {'height': 375, 'width': 1242, 'channels': 3}). Omit this field when there is no single dataset-wide shape.

file_types.description: Observed data file types for this modality, stored as lowercase extensions without leading dots (for example ['jpg', 'png']).

non_finite.description: Whether NaN or infinite values can appear; they mark invalid pixels.

sentinel.description: The finite value that marks invalid pixels, or null for none.

invalid.description: How pixels without a valid value are marked in the values the loader returns: 'sentinel' is the finite value that marks them (null: none), and 'non_finite' whether NaN or infinite values can appear, which then mark invalid pixels too. The same shape and meaning as a representation profile's 'invalid'. Omitted: not declared, so consumers apply their own rule (for depth, a value that is non-finite or not positive is invalid).

sparse.description: Whether the raster holds measurements at only some of its pixels, the rest invalid as 'invalid' declares (without it, consumers take 0 for depth), as in lidar-derived depth or disparity. Consumers must not interpolate between samples: a resize moves each measurement to its nearest target pixel, keeping the nearest surface, and evaluation scores the measured pixels. Default false.

source_grid.description: How this dataset's pixel grid derives from the grid of the images it was computed from, such as a prediction from its model input: the source [height, width] and the affine [[sx, 0, tx], [0, sy, ty]] mapping source pixel centres to this grid (K_out = T @ K_in). A file's attributes.source_grid overrides it for that sample.

radial_depth.description: Whether the depth values represent radial (euclidean) distance from the camera rather than perpendicular (z-buffer) depth.

range.description: Value range of the depth values in meters (e.g. [0, 65535] for VKITTI2).

scale_to_meters.description: Factor that converts raw depth values to meters (e.g. 0.001 when stored in millimetres).

skyclass.description: Sky label of the segmentation map as an RGB triple: the value of a sky pixel when the stored file is viewed as RGB. A colour-coded map uses the sky colour (e.g. [90, 200, 255]); a single-channel class map uses [v, v, v] for sky label v (e.g. [23, 23, 23] for Cityscapes label IDs, [10, 10, 10] for train IDs); a class ID stored in one channel of a colour file keeps the other channels' values (e.g. [29, 0, 0] for an ID in the red channel). null, the default, leaves the sky undeclared: a loader then uses its own default for the dataset, or rejects the head if it has none.
